description: SPL-token escrow for AI-agent payments, on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.30.1). create_escrow, fund_escrow, start_work, submit_work and confirm_completion were verified end-to-end: 1_000_000 units escrowed, the provider received 995_000, a 0.5% fee (5_000) went to the lab treasury, and the vault was emptied. The lab also fixes an upstream vault-PDA bump typo so payouts can sign.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of AgentEscrow23/agentescrow. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/agentescrow. The lab changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program and fixed release/refund to sign with the vault PDA bump (ctx.bumps.vault) instead of escrow.bump. The hosted IDL is a hand-derived subset confirmed by the verifying transactions. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; the vault-bump fix is offered upstream as an ordinary pull request and acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (create_escrow, fund_escrow, start_work, submit_work, confirm_completion)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/agentescrow/
QA: devnet proof of the full escrow lifecycle, 0.5% fee split, and recreate rejection
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Add a nonce or counter to escrow PDA seeds so one payer can open more than one escrow
